title: Development Module Config v1
description: Validation and workspace behavior for one Development Module Instance.

validationOrder.title: Validation order
validationOrder.description: Checks run after implementation, in this order.

items.title: Validation check
items.description: A project command to run during validation.

maxRepairCycles.title: Maximum repair cycles
maxRepairCycles.description: Maximum implementation repair attempts after validation fails.

preparation.title: Worktree preparation
preparation.description: Confirmed preparation before the Agent Runtime: run the configured install command, or explicitly confirm that no preparation is necessary.

retainWorkspaceOnSuccess.title: Retain successful workspace
retainWorkspaceOnSuccess.description: Keep the temporary Git workspace after a successful execution.

timeoutMs.title: Agent timeout
timeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of one Agent Runtime session.

outputLimitBytes.title: Agent output limit
outputLimitBytes.description: Maximum captured output for one Agent Runtime session.

environmentAllowlist.title: Agent environment allowlist
environmentAllowlist.description: Environment variable names explicitly allowed in the Agent Runtime process.
